sources: Travel Reimbursement Policy. Employees can claim travel reimbursement within 30 days of the trip. Claims above Rs. 50,000 require approval from the finance head. Original receipts must be uploaded as PDF files on the expense portal. Economy class air travel is allowed for trips longer than 500 km; trains must be used for shorter trips.

Leave Policy. Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Up to 8 unused days can be carried forward to the next year. Sick leave of more than 3 consecutive days requires a medical certificate. Leave requests must be submitted at least 7 days in advance, except for emergencies.

IT Security Policy. Passwords must be at least 12 characters long and are rotated every 90 days. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for VPN and email access. Company laptops must have full-disk encryption enabled. Lost devices must be reported to the IT helpdesk within 24 hours.

Returns and Refunds Policy. Customers can return unused products within 15 days of delivery for a full refund. Refunds are credited to the original payment method within 7 working days. Digital downloads and gift cards are not eligible for return. Shipping charges are refunded only if the product arrived damaged.
